title: Re: Abazabaddon
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abazabaddon and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 1A: Thumb Knuckles, Hairy Wrists, and Bulbous Elbows then Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Abazabaddon and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 1A: Thumb Knuckles, Hairy Wrists, and Bulbous Elbows then Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Look, I know you took care of Abazabaddon already, but he is stubborn, so you need to do it again. If it was up to me, I wouldn't make you do this, but it isn't my fault that these monsters just don't know when to stay dead!

Get back in there and take care of Abazabaddon and those creepy Abba Labbas then return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, when you are done.

Turn-in:

Good job back there. Here is something for your efforts and let me know if you would like to try it again.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abazabaddon
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Level range: 40–46
